name: Cassock
description: A long black robe buttoned from the collar to the hem, with a standing collar and a white tab at the throat, as a priest wears it.
notes: Folded in four layers, 360 mm by 300 mm and 60 mm tall, with the thirteen small buttons down the front, the standing collar along the back and the white collar tab before it. Slot `torso`, as the jacket has it; it also reaches the legs, and Deadvox has no long-coat slot. The reference marks it as worn under a belt. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Faux fur coat
description: A loud pink coat of synthetic fur with a rolled collar, toggles down the front and two small pockets. Not as warm as real fur, but hard to miss.
notes: Folded in three layers, 380 mm by 320 mm and 60 mm tall, with the shawl collar rolled along the back, a cream lining edge with three toggles down the front and two patch pockets. The pink is one of many loud colours; a colour variant would give its own `finishes`. Slot `torso`, as the jacket has it; it also reaches the legs. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Fur coat
description: A heavy brown fur coat lined with cotton, with a deep collar and two small pockets. Very warm.
notes: Folded in three layers, 380 mm by 320 mm and 60 mm tall, with the deep fur collar rolled along the back, a leather-bound front edge with three buttons and two patch pockets. Slot `torso`, as the jacket has it; it also reaches the legs. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Gutskin parka
description: A hooded parka sewn from bands of split and dried intestine. Light, translucent and fully waterproof, but thin.
notes: Folded thin in three layers, 300 mm by 240 mm and 30 mm tall, with the sewn seams between the bands of gut running across it and the hood folded down on top with a dark bound rim. Gut is drawn with the `skin-rawhide` finish. Box/volume x2.6: the reference packs the parka tighter than a folded stack. Slot `torso`, as the jacket has it. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Lab coat
description: A long white cotton coat with lapels, two large hip pockets and a breast pocket fitted with a plastic pocket protector.
notes: Folded in three layers, 340 mm by 280 mm and 30 mm tall, with notched lapels either side of the buttoned front, two hip pockets and a breast pocket whose clear pocket protector holds a blue and a red pen. The pens are part of the model, not items in the pocket. Slot `torso`, as the jacket has it. Box/volume x2.1: the folded stack holds air the reference's packed volume does not. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Rain coat
description: A hooded yellow vinyl coat that snaps shut down the front, with two very large flapped pockets. Keeps the rain off and not much else.
notes: Folded in three layers, 320 mm by 260 mm and 25 mm tall, with the hood folded down on top, four steel snaps down the front and two large flapped pockets. The reference lists no materials; vinyl is drawn with `plastic-yellow`. Slot `torso`, as the jacket has it. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Winter coat
description: A padded, quilted coat with a fur-trimmed hood, a zip up the front and two deep pockets. Very warm.
notes: Folded in three layers, 380 mm by 320 mm and 65 mm tall, with quilted baffles across the body, the hood folded down on top with its fur-trimmed rim, a black zip and two flapped pockets. Slot `torso`, as the jacket has it. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

notes: Folded in five layers, 380 mm by 320 mm and 60 mm tall, with the shoulder cape lying over the back half, the collar rolled along the back, three buttons and two flapped hip pockets; the two inside pockets are not drawn. Slot `torso`, as the jacket has it; it also reaches the legs. The reference marks it as worn under a belt. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

notes: Folded in four layers, 300 mm by 240 mm and 20 mm tall, with the two eye holes showing as dark ovals on the top fold. The hat worn under the sheet is not drawn; it is any hat the wearer has. Slot `cloak`, as the cape and the flag have it; it also covers the eyes and mouth. The reference marks it as worn under a belt. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Reaper robe
